sec: MEN2A variants, MEN2B/MEN3 and MEN4 · p860

items.q: Match classical MEN2A frequencies — 1) Medullary thyroid cancer  2) Pheochromocytoma  3) Parathyroid hyperplasia … A) 50%  B) 25%  C) 100%
items.exp: Classical MEN2A: MTC 100% + pheochromocytoma 50% + parathyroid hyperplasia 25%. (Book p860)

items.q: The MEN2A variants listed are classical MEN2A plus:
opts: Cutaneous lichen amyloidosis, Hirschsprung's disease, and FMTC
items.exp: Variants: MEN2A + cutaneous lichen amyloidosis; MEN2A + Hirschsprung's disease; familial medullary thyroid cancer (FMTC). (Book p860)

items.q: MEN2B/MEN3 combines medullary thyroid carcinoma (100%) and pheochromocytoma (50%) with:
opts: Marfanoid habitus, mucosal & intestinal ganglioneuromatosis, myelinated corneal nerve fibres
items.exp: MEN2B/MEN3: marfanoid habitus, mucosal & intestinal ganglioneuromatosis, myelinated corneal nerve fibres. (Book p860)

items.q: The tongue image on p860 illustrates:
items.exp: The photograph shows mucosal ganglioneuromatosis of the tongue. (Book p860)

items.q: MEN4 is caused by mutation of ___.
MEN4 manifestations include parathyroid hyperplasia (adenoma), pituitary and:
items.exp: MEN4: parathyroid hyperplasia (adenoma) + pituitary + renal/adrenal tumours + testicular/ovarian tumours. (Book p860)
